11366.html:
11366 vártman n. 'track of a wheel, path' RV. [J. Bloch StudII 19 *vartmā nom. sg. m. after ádhvā m. (cf. pánthā-) became f. in MIA. — √vr̥t¹]
    Pa. vaṭuma- n. 'path, road', Pk. vaṭṭa- n.m., vaṭṭā- f., vaṭṭamaya-, vaḍū̆maga- n., K. wath, dat. °ti f., pog. wat, S. vāṭa f., P. vāṭ, bāṭ f., ḍog. batta f., kgr. bat f., bhaṭ. batt, WPah.bhad. bhal. paṅ. cam. batt f., pāḍ. cur. bat; Ku. bāṭ 'path, pass', bāṭo m. 'path', N. bāṭo (obl. bāṭa postp. 'from'), A. B. bāṭ; Or. bāṭa 'path, place'; Mth. bāṭ 'path', Bhoj. bāt, OAw. OMarw. bāṭa f., H. bāṭ f., G. M. Ko. vāṭ f.; Si. vaṭuma 'road' (← Pa.?), devaṭa 'lane' (de- < dēśá- ?); — Sh. bāṭṷ m. 'wheel'; G. vāṭɔ m. 'tire' (semant. cf. vartaní- f. 'felly of wheel, path' RV., Pa. vattanī- f. 'track, path', Pk. vaṭṭaṇī- f. 'road'). — Deriv.: N. baṭuwā 'traveller'; B. beṭo 'of the road' < *bāṭuā ODBL 491; Or. bāṭuā 'traveller', G. vāṭvɔ m. — X mārga- q.v. — Si. vat 'road' (LM 404, EGS 155) extracted from māvat < *mahāpanthā-. — See vartís- from which some of above NIA. feminine words may phonet. equally well derive.
    *vartmapathika-, *vartmapānīya-, vartmapāla-; *avartmaka- Add., udvartman-, kuvartman-, *gāḍḍavartman-, *gōcaravartman-, *caturvartman-, trivartman-, *duvartmaka-, dvāravartman-, *pādavartman-, *siddhavartman-, suvartman-.
    Addenda: vártman-: WPah.kṭg. bāt, kc. bāṭ f. (obl. -a), J. bā'ṭ f.; Garh. bāṭu 'way'.

1697.html:
1697 uḍḍīyatē 'flies up' MBh. 2. uḍḍayatē MBh. 3. X *uddrāti. 4. Caus. uḍḍāpayati. [For discussion of ḍ see √ḍī]
    1. Gy. gr. ury-, wel. ōrī-, SEeur. ui̦i- JGLS new ser. iv 293 'to fly'.
    2. Pa. uḍḍēti 'flies up'; Pk. uḍḍēi 'flies', K. wuḍun, L. uḍḍaṇ, (Jukes) uḍ̠aṇ, P. uḍḍṇā, EP. uṛnā (← H.), Ku. uṛṇo, N. uṛnu, A. uriba, B. uṛā, oṛā, Or. uṛibā, Bi. ūṛab, OMth. ūḍaï, Bhoj. uṛal, Aw. lakh. uṛab, H. uṛnā, OMarw. ūḍaï, G. uḍvũ, M. uḍṇẽ, Ko. uḍtā.
    3. S. uḍ̠iraṇu 'to fly', L. (Jukes) uḍ̠raṇ (whence caus. uḍ̠āraṇ), P. ḍog. uḍḍarnā, WPah. khaś. uḍarṇu, bhal. uḍirṇu; — S. uḍ̠āmaṇu (X ?).
    4. Pk. uḍḍāvaï 'causes to fly up', K. wuḍāwun, kash. uḍāunᵘ; S. uḍ̠āiṇu 'to cause to fly, to squander', L. uḍ̠āvaṇ, P. uḍāuṇā, WPah. bhad. uḍāṇū, Ku. uṛūṇo, N. uṛāunu, B. uṛāna, oṛ°, Or. uṛāibā, H. uṛānā, G. uḍāvvũ, uḍāṛvũ, urāḍvũ, M. uḍaviṇẽ; — prob. Phal. uṛūm 'I leave, let loose' (wī uṛū́m 'I irrigate').
    Cf. *uddīyati.
    Addenda: uḍḍīyatē [Turner BSOAS xlii 2, 359 et seq.]
    1. Gy.eur. (Slovak) urnando mišos 'bat' Arch. Or. 34, 471.
    2. uḍḍayatē: S.kcch. auḍṇū 'to fly'.
    3. (X *uddrāti) WPah.Wkc. ḍwāṇo, ḍyāṇo (< *ḍwyā- < *uḍḍiyā-) 'to fly'.
    4. uḍḍāpayati: Wkc. ḍwauṇo caus.
    5. †*uddayati: WPah.kc. vṛṇo 'to fly' (udd- > udᶻd- > uẓ̌ḍ- > ūṛ-), kṭg. ṛεuṇõ, ṛε῀ṇõ (and poss. all forms in 2. uḍḍayatē which can represent -ḍ- or -ḍḍ-) rather than < *uddriyāti X *uddrāti.
    6. †*uddāpayati: WPah.kṭg. ṛauṇõ 'causes to fly away, drives away (birds etc.)' or < *uddrāvayati.

11363.html:
11363 vartís n. 'journey (= mārga- Mahīdh.)' RV. [√vr̥t¹]
    Gy. pers. vātī 'path', L. vāṭ, pl. vaṭī˜ f.; Si. väṭi-ya 'dam between fields serving as a path' (or < vártra- ?), väṭu 'path'. — See vártman-.
    vartīra- see vártikā-.

12992.html:
12992 saṁrajyatē MBh. 'is affected by passion' MW. [saṁrañiayati 'pleases' BhP. — √raj]
    Pa. sārajjati 'is pleased with'; — altern. < *saṁrādhyati: NiDoc. sarajitaṁti 'they agreed'; Wg. saraz- 'to agree' (NTS xvii 297 < *saṁ-raj- cf. Av. ham-raz- 'to bring into order'). — Anal. MIA. pres. st. -racc- (see rájyatē): S. sarcaṇu 'to be appeased, be satisfied, be reconciled', caus. sarcāiṇu.
    Addenda: saṁrajyatē: S. sarcaṇu, WPah.kṭg. (kc.) sɔ́rċṇõ 'to be reconciled, come to an understanding' rather < *saṁracyatē.
